extraction.description: The screenshot shows a UiPath workflow/BPMN-style designer for a Benefit Claims Processing automation. The selected element is the decision gateway labeled “Applicant Eligible?”, with Yes and No paths leading to approval and rejection email generation/sending steps. On the right, the Conditions properties panel is open, showing the No path set as the default path and the Yes path configured with the condition `vars.action == "Approve"`; an expression editor menu is open with “JS expression editor” highlighted.
step_instructions: Click on the “Applicant Eligible?” gateway to configure its outgoing conditions.
In the No condition section, ensure the Label field is set to “No” and turn on “Make default path”.
In the Yes condition section, ensure the Label field is set to “Yes”.
In the Yes Condition field, enter `vars.action == "Approve"`.
Click the expression editor/options icon next to the Condition field, then select “JS expression editor” from the menu.
